operation_proposals.source_operation: Aspect-ratio-preserving image resize with conditional padding and grayscale-to-three-channel conversion
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has reshape, pad, and augment, but no operation representing this combined image transformation. It remains an opaque boundary.

operation_proposals.source_operation: DeepVariant pileup channel repacking from six channels into an RGB image-like representation
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper specifies a channel-to-height repacking from (100, 221, 6) to (200, 221, 3). Existing primitives do not establish that correspondence.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Interleaving visual-token blocks at source-defined positions among text-token spans
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no operation whose declared interface represents insertion of one or more modality-token blocks into text spans while preserving an unknown source-defined schedule. The context-construction step remains an opaque boundary.
